hooks.text: 一百名灵体盟友既能补组合，也可能彻底改写整套麻将核心玩法
hooks.excerpt: 100 unique spirit allies , each capable of helping you form distinctive strategies or completely changing your core gameplay.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三十五种供品能操纵手牌、牌库甚至运气，牌灵与变体再强化麻将牌
hooks.excerpt: 35 offerings grant special abilities, allowing you to manipulate your hand/deck and even improve your "luck." 17 tile spirits and 12 tile variants enhance your Mahjong tiles, enabling you to unleash even more powerful effects.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 二十四名冥界Boss各带主动与被动技能，需要逐个研究专属破解路线
hooks.excerpt: Accompanying you on each journey through the underworld are 24 unique bosses , including Granny Meng, Ox-Head and Horse-Face, and the Four Judges. Each boss has their own active and passive skills . Study them to find your path to victory!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
